target.title: FS1 section 5.7: contract with an IPP to be sought for a Build-Own-Operate island power station; proposals received from five WA IPPs

availability_evidence.note: Same ASX release as s1 (18/02/2021 8:48 am Sydney time, AEDT +11:00, idsId=02342810). Agent-asserted from an ASX listing retrieved by curl and not captured.

target.source_quote:
A contract with an established Independent Power Producer (IPP) will be sought to construct a gas-only or dualfuel island power station with solar renewables contribution. This will be a Build-Own-Operate (BOO) model 
selling unit rate power (“kWh rate”) via a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA).

Proposals have been received from five (5) reputable WA-based IPPs with varying configurations of engines, fuels, 
renewables contributions, contract terms, and chargeable fixed and variable rates. The site peak load is estimated 
to be approximately 10MW with an average load of approximately 8.5MW. It is expected that at least 2MW of 
solar capacity will be incorporated into the station.
target.target_description: Stage One Feasibility Study section 5.7 (same ASX release as s1): an IPP contract on a BOO/PPA basis will be sought and proposals have already been received from five WA IPPs. Earliest procurement-type event found (proposal solicitation); it is in the SAME release as the only signal, so the measured lead time is about zero and the case offers no earlier power signal.
